stem: Bernard knows his pacelength is 0.80 metres. The formula applies to Bernard's walking. Calculate Bernard's walking speed in metres per minute and in kilometres per hour. Show your work.
correctAnswer: 89.6 metres per minute and 5.38 km/hr (rounding acceptable: 90 m/min and 5.3–5.4 km/hr)
steps: Speed = n × P = 112 × 0.80 = 89.6 metres per minute

full.description: Both correct: ~89.6 m/min AND ~5.38 km/hr (rounding errors acceptable)

partial.description: Only one value correct, or correct method with minor arithmetic errors, or n=112 found but speed not completed

none.description: No valid method shown or completely wrong approach
